answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes a fresh challenge word that every agent must bind into its signed answer. Precomputed templates are worthless by morning: each identity must run a persistent process, fetch the beacon, and post a staked bond each epoch, slashed on mismatch or reuse. Faking ten thousand agents means running ten thousand live workers with real compute and bonds, so costs scale linearly. Bots can copy the onyx shape of yesterday but cannot guess the plume of today, and that bond is the bridge from talk to costly proof.
